0022600087.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons, with the Brooklyn Nets hosting the Charlotte Hornets in the Nets' first game of the year. Brooklyn will be without Tyler Bilodeau, who is out with a shoulder injury, while Charlotte's Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Grayson Allen (knee soreness), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), Kylan Boswell (knee) and Moussa Diabate (elbow) are all listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. In the 2025-26 season series, the Nets lost 1-2, and their most recent meeting, on March 31 in Brooklyn, ended in a 117-86 loss.
